acceptanceCriteria: A side whose setup calls an unresolved first-party helper (defined in the suite, not a recognised factory form) is followed to its factory calls when statically resolvable, otherwise the side is SEED-PARITY-NOT-ANALYSED naming the helper and line.
Fixture: two tests with identical visible factory calls but different helper-seeded records no longer report parity.
body: Residual from V1-1883 (PR #1178, TSA-V0-107 failure modes). `corvint tests validity --legacy` reads FactoryBot/fixtures/JS create/build forms only; a side that seeds through a helper such as make_order(...) is not seen, so 'parity' can be reported although the helper's records differ. Invariant 2: missing evidence must abstain.
title: Seed parity reports parity over setup helpers it cannot see (make_order-style helpers without a setup word)
